definition.def: If you modify something, you change it slightly, usually in order to improve it.
examples: The club members did agree to modify their recruitment policy. [VERB noun]
The plane was a modified version of the C-130. [VERB-ed]

definition.def: A word or group of words that modifies another word describes or classifies something, or restricts the meaning of the word. [technical]
examples: It is a rule of English that adjectives generally precede the noun they modify: we say 'a good cry', not 'a cry good'. [VERB noun]

definition.def: the act or process of changing something in order to improve it or make it more acceptable; a change that is made
examples: Considerable modification of the existing system is needed.
It might be necessary to make a few slight modifications to the design.

examples.sentence: Pharmaceutical science and chemistry built on these ancient foundations and perfected the extraction, characterisation, modification and testing of these natural products.

Racket customisation and modification have pushed the standards of the game to greater levels that few could have anticipated in the days of natural strings and heavy, wooden frames, and it's exciting to see what further developments there will be in the future.
